_comments: Which SECTION of the generated Contract Type form the four renewal defaults appear in.
EntityField.Category is MJ metadata, so it belongs here rather than in a migration — the
same reason .contract-type-field-categories.json carries the section's icon and
description. CodeGen's AI categorisation assigns a Category only when it runs its advanced
generation pass over a new field; it did not on the from-zero replay, and four uncategorised
fields render in a generic Details block instead of 'Default Contract Terms'. Stating it here
makes the grouping a fact of the repo rather than a by-product of a model call.
GeneratedFormSection = 'Category' is what tells CodeGen to group by Category at all; every other
categorised field on this entity carries it.
